Type: cabinet
Name: Stone & Beam Farmhouse Wall Mounted Cabinet Storage Organzier - 23 x19 x 6 Inch, Natural Wood (Renewed)
Colors: Natural
Materials: Wood
This wall cabinet provides vintage style along with storage space for spices, mail and more in your kitchen or entryway. Display small objects or stash your keys in the three cubbies on the bottom. The distressed finish adds to the antique appeal. 19.25" W x 23.25" H x 6.75" D Constructed from hardwood; iron hinges and door pulls Ready to hang, all hardware included
